38054-a-duel.title: A Duel
38054-a-duel.creator: Richard Marsh
38054-a-duel.description: A book by Richard Marsh. Isabel waited till the rat-tat was repeated a second time, then she went down to the front door. Macconichie and her husband were both out, and she had the house to herself, there was nothing else for her to do, unless she wished the postman to depart with the letters. As it was, when she appeared at the door, he grumbled at being delayed.

arxiv-2205-13448.title: Validated Objects: Specification, Implementation, and Applications
arxiv-2205-13448.creator: Antonio Fernández Anta, Chryssis Georgiou, Nicolas Nicolaou, Antonio Russo
arxiv-2205-13448.description: Abstract Guaranteeing the validity of concurrent operations on distributed objects is a key property for ensuring reliability and consistency in distributed systems. Usually, the methods for validating these operations, if present, are wired in the object implementation. In this work, we formalize the notion of a validated object , decoupling the object operations and properties from the validation procedure.

arxiv-2406-00359.title: Location Privacy in B5G/6G: Systematization of Knowledge
arxiv-2406-00359.creator: Hannah B. Pasandi, Faith Parastar
arxiv-2406-00359.description: Abstract . As we transition into the era of B5G/6G networks, the promise of seamless, high-speed connectivity brings unprecedented opportunities and challenges. Among the most critical concerns is the preservation of location privacy, given the enhanced precision and pervasive connectivity of these advanced networks.

pmc-11676184.title: Exploring the Linkage Between Ruminal Microbial Communities on Postweaning and Finishing Diets and Their Relation to Residual Feed Intake in Beef Cattle
pmc-11676184.creator: Pablo Peraza, Tamara Fernández-Calero, Hugo Naya, José Sotelo-Silveira, Elly A Navajas, Marianna Marangi
pmc-11676184.description: Feed efficiency significantly impacts the economics of beef production and is influenced by biological and environmental factors. The rumen microbiota plays a crucial role in efficiency, with studies increasingly focused on its relationship with different rearing systems. This study analyzed 324 rumen samples from bulls and steers categorized as high and low efficiency based on residual feed intake.

pmc-12588749.title: Potential Off-Target Effect of Gilteritinib With Venetoclax Decreases Tumor Burden for Patients With Relapsed/Refractory Wild-Type FLT3 Acute Myeloid Leukemia/Myelodysplastic Neoplasms
pmc-12588749.creator: Shuting Chang, Zhijuan Pan, Yiqun Zhang, Ying Zhang, Jiajia Sun, Yanru Guo, Xinlei Guo, Zhiping Guo
pmc-12588749.description: Many tyrosine kinase inhibitors show nonspecific activity against multiple kinases, causing off-target effects when used in a broad patient population. This study evaluated the effectiveness of gilteritinib combined with venetoclax in patients with relapsed/refractory (R/R) acute myeloid leukemia (AML) or myelodysplastic neoplasms (MDS) with wild-type FLT3, who currently lack targeted therapy.

pmc-12644696.title: The effect of recess number and conical shape on hydrostatic bearing power losses
pmc-12644696.creator: Marwa M El-Sayed, Masoud Ibrahim, Ahmed S A Abou Taleb
pmc-12644696.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Axial loads on machinery are commonly carried by hydrostatic thrust bearings. To ensure sustained performance, designers need to balance the requirement for efficient pumping power with the high load-carrying capacity. This requirement is a common challenge. For the purpose of studying the pumping power losses of hydrostatic thrust bearings, this research presents a numerical analysis of the recess shape design effect. The ANSYS workbench software has been used to implement the numerical simulation.

pmc-13021580.title: Evaluating climbing interventions for Parkinson's disease: a systematic review
pmc-13021580.creator: Ryan Alexander Smith, Allison Anne Hellman
pmc-13021580.description: IntroductionExercise ameliorates symptoms and may modify disease progression in people with Parkinson's disease (PD). Climbing is an increasingly popular form of exercise with characteristics that may be well suited to addressing the symptoms of PD. This systematic review aims to synthesize and evaluate climbing-based intervention studies for PD.MethodsThis review was not registered.

pmc-13057145.title: Sustainable polyurethane-based dielectric composites from industrial and E-waste for high-voltage insulation applications
pmc-13057145.creator: Vinoth Kumar Selvaraj, Jeyanthi Subramanian, Gokul Selvanathan, Nitesh Verma Kannammaraju, Vijayakumar Rajendran
pmc-13057145.description: The growing demand for sustainable materials in electrical and electronic applications has led to the reuse of industrial and electronic waste in high-performance polymer composites. In this study, rigid polyurethane foam waste (WRPU), recycled tire waste (RTW), and printed circuit board (PCB) scraps were incorporated as fillers into a polyurethane matrix using methylene diphenyl diisocyanate (MDI) as a binder.

pmc-13366593.title: Beyond the arterial line: less, more, or smarter use?
pmc-13366593.creator: Paul Abraham, Thomas Rimmele, Sylvain Mauron, Patrick Schoettker, Karim Bendjelid
pmc-13366593.description: ck could be safe under controlled conditions. Surprisingly, the investigators reported no significant difference in mortality or major adverse events between patients managed with early invasive monitoring and those managed with non-invasive monitoring strategies. pmc-13380539.title: Exploring the Dynamic Interplay of Carbon Nanotubes with Apoptosis In-vitro and In-vivo: Insights from Bcl-2 and IAP Families
pmc-13380539.creator: Shirin Lotfipanah, Leila Saremi, Yasaminsadat Rafieitabatabaei, Masoud Asgari, Zahra Hajebrahimi
pmc-13380539.description: Background: Carbon nanotubes (CNTs) are carbon-based nanomaterials. They have been widely used in environmental technologies and in biomedical fields.Objectives: This study examines the impact of carboxyl-functionalized multi-walled (MWCNTs) and single-walled carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) on apoptosis in Jurkat cells and Wistar rats.

pmc-13429531.title: Safety and Effectiveness in 400 Image-Guided Spleen Biopsies from the DeGIR Registry
pmc-13429531.creator: R. Ocker-Serger, M. Opitz, L. Klüner, M. Drews, D. Rosok, L. Salhoefer, M. Forsting, J. Haubold, B. M. Schaarschmidt, S. Zensen
pmc-13429531.description: PurposeTo evaluate technical success, diagnostic yield, and complication rates of image-guided percutaneous splenic biopsies based on multicenter registry data from the German Society for Interventional Radiology and Minimally Invasive Therapy.Materials and MethodsThis retrospective multicenter study analyzed image-guided percutaneous splenic biopsies documented in the prospective DeGIR registry between 2018 and 2024.

pmc-13462967.title: Parametric sweep assessment of cross-slit cylinders for passive drag reduction and wake modification
pmc-13462967.creator: G. Madhan Kumar, K. M. Kumar, T. Mothilal
pmc-13462967.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This paper presents a detailed numerical investigation and parametric sweep assessment of cross-slit (CS) cylindrical configurations aimed at passive drag reduction and wake modification in low to transitional Reynolds number regimes relevant to marine and offshore applications. A series of two-dimensional laminar CFD simulations were performed at Reynolds numbers of 100, 150, and 300 to analyze the influence of slit width ratio (SWR = 0.10–0.25) and sweep angle on wake dynamics, drag, lift, and vortex shedding characteristics.

pmc-7617827.title: Two co-dependent routes lead to high-level MRSA
pmc-7617827.creator: Abimbola Feyisara Adedeji-Olulana, Katarzyna Wacnik, Lucia Lafage, Laia Pasquina-Lemonche, Mariana Tinajero-Trejo, Joshua A. F. Sutton, Bohdan Bilyk, Sophie E. Irving, Callum J. Portman Ross, Oliver J. Meacock, Sam A. Randerson, Ewan Beattie, David S. Owen, James Florence, William M. Durham, David P
pmc-7617827.description: Methicillin resistant S. aureus (MRSA) is of major clinical concern, in which acquisition of mecA, encoding the cell wall peptidoglycan biosynthesis component Penicillin Binding Protein 2a (PBP2a), confers resistance to β-lactam antibiotics. In the presence of antibiotics we show that MRSA adopts an alternative cell division mode, with altered peptidoglycan architecture at the division septum.
